title: Zeitenwende: The All Encompassing Shift in German Strategic Thinking
gist: An Unspent Rounds episode note: Claudia Major argues that the Zeitenwende declared by Olaf Scholz in 2022 is widely misread as a purely military and defense reform agenda, when it is in fact an all-encompassing mindset shift across German society.

insights.claim: The common assumption that Germany's Zeitenwende refers only to transformative military and defense reform is wrong; it is better understood as an all-encompassing mindset shift in German society.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: If the shift is societal rather than budgetary, German rearmament and strategic realignment are more durable across election cycles than defense-spending headlines alone suggest — supportive for the long-run European defense thesis.
insights.quote: Claudia Major explains why Zeitenwende is actually an all-encompassing mindset shift in German society
